FROM meeting WHERE label IS NOT NULL ), mem AS ( SELECT DISTINCT dk.doc_id AS doc_id, pk.pack_id AS pack_id FROM (SELECT cr, pack_id FROM cr_in_pack UNION SELECT cr, pack_id FROM pack_member) e JOIN dk ON dk.k = e.cr JOIN pk ON pk.k = e.pack_id ), mods AS ( SELECT DISTINCT dk.doc_id AS doc_id, e.section_id AS section_id FROM (SELECT cr, section_id FROM cr_modifies_section UNION SELECT cr, section_id FROM section_modified_by) e JOIN dk ON dk.k = e.cr ), disp AS ( SELECT DISTINCT dk.doc_id AS doc_id, d.code AS code, COALESCE(m.label, m.id) AS wg_meeting FROM disposition d JOIN dk ON dk.k = d.target JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN mk ON mk.k = r.meeting_id JOIN meeting m ON m.id = mk.meeting_id WHERE LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(d.evidence_status),'_',''),'-',''),' ','')) IN ('sourceverified','verifiedsource','verifiedfromsource') AND d.scope = 'whole_target' AND LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(m.wg),'_',''),'-',''),' ','')) IN ('ran5','r5','ranwg5','tsgranwg5','wg5') ), P AS ( SELECT id AS pack_id, tsg_number AS tn FROM cr_pack WHERE pack_number = 'RP-240961' OR id = 'RP-240961' ), base AS ( SELECT DISTINCT s.spec AS spec, s.release AS rel, s.clause AS clause, P.tn AS tn FROM P JOIN mem ON mem.pack_id = P.pack_id JOIN document doc ON doc.id = mem.doc_id JOIN mods ON mods.doc_id = doc.id JOIN section s ON s.id = mods.section_id WHERE LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(s.release)),'release',''),'rel',''),'-',''),' ',''),'r') = LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(doc.target_release)),'release',''),'rel',''),'-',''),' ',''),'r') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM disp WHERE disp.doc_id = doc.id) ), cand AS ( SELECT DISTINCT b.spec AS spec, b.rel AS rel, b.clause AS clause, b.tn AS tn, COALESCE(cp.pack_number, cp.id) AS pack_number, cp.tsg_meeting AS tsg_meeting, cp.tsg_number AS ptn FROM base b JOIN section s2 cp.id = me2.pack_id WHERE LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(d2.target_release)),'release',''),'rel',''),'-',''),' ',''),'r') = LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(s2.release)),'release',''),'rel',''),'-',''),' ',''),'r') AND cp.tsg_number < b.tn ) SELECT DISTINCT c.spec AS specification, c.clause AS clause,
